title: 第262章 孙女婿第261章 女帝深不可测
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
次日一早。
纳兰风云的马车，停在镇北王府外。
“雪嫣，去吧。”
“爷爷，我害怕……”
纳兰雪嫣低着头，俏脸红到耳根子。
纳兰风云脸色严肃：“雪嫣，叶凡现在可是香饽饽，以后他的人生中，绝对不会缺女人。”
“爷爷之前就说过，大夏只是一个浅滩，困不住这条真龙。”
“你现在抓不住叶凡，未来，可就晚了！”
纳兰雪嫣红着脸，扭扭捏捏：“爷爷，不是……我害羞……”
“哈哈哈哈！”
纳兰风云大笑：“有什么好害羞的？”
“女人都要经历这一遭，说实话，你喜不喜欢叶凡？”
纳兰雪嫣羞涩的低着头，点了点头：“小时候我就喜欢他……可是……我还没准备好。”
……
早上吃完早饭后，叶凡就来到唐妙衣的工作坊内。
一直快到中午，纳兰雪嫣才姗姗来迟。
叶凡笑道：“我之前听人说，你每天来的挺早，今天怎么迟到了？”
纳兰雪嫣怯生生的走进来。
一张俏脸，红噗噗的跟苹果一样！
两只手慌乱的玩弄着衣角。

叶凡调笑：“唐妙衣离开的时候，有没有要求你做什么？”
纳兰雪嫣看了叶凡一眼，又羞涩的低下头：“妙衣姐说了，只要你需要，我做什么都可以……”
叶凡继续调笑：“真的做什么都可以吗？”
纳兰雪嫣的俏脸通红，低着头：“可以……但是你不能欺负我……”
“我欺负你干嘛？”
叶凡摇了摇头，面色一正：“我需要你的双手！”
“啊？双手就可以了吗？”
昨天晚上，纳兰风云给纳兰雪嫣，做了许多心理建设！
甚至府邸的一些老嬷嬷，连夜被纳兰风云请过来，给纳兰雪嫣上了一堂成人课！大家族小姐出嫁之前，都有这种老嬷嬷，专门上课！
还配合一些图画，纳兰嫣然现在的小脑袋里，全都是那一幅幅画面。
虽然，有一些图画里面，是用双手的。
可是，纳兰雪嫣已经做好献身的准备：“只用手就可以了吗？”
叶凡笑道：“怎么？你不会？”
“呃……我学过了。”
content_en:
Early the next morning.
Nalan Fengyun's carriage stopped outside Zhenbei Prince's Mansion.
"Xueyan, go."
"Grandpa, I'm afraid..."
Nalan Xueyan lowered her head, her pretty face flushed to her ears.
Nalan Fengyun's face was serious: "Xue Yan, Ye Fan is very popular now, and he will definitely not lack women in his life in the future."
"Grandpa said before that Daxia is just a shoal and cannot trap this real dragon."
"If you can't catch Mark now, it will be too late in the future!"
Nalan Xueyan blushed and squirmed: "Grandpa, no... I'm shy..."
"Hahahaha!"
Nalan Fengyun laughed: "What is there to be ashamed of?"
"Every woman has to go through this. To be honest, do you like Mark?"
Nalan Xueyan lowered her head shyly and nodded: "I liked him when I was a child...but...I'm not ready yet."
…
After breakfast in the morning, Ye Fan came to Tang Miaoyi's workshop.
It was almost noon when Nalan Xueyan arrived belatedly.
Ye Fan smiled and said: "I heard someone say before that you come very early every day, why are you late today?"
Nalan Xueyan walked in timidly.
A pretty face, as red as an apple!
His two hands frantically played with the corners of his clothes.
Ye Fan teased: "Did Tang Miaoyi ask you to do anything when he left?"
Nalan Xueyan glanced at Ye Fan, then lowered her head shyly: "Sister Miaoyi said, as long as you need it, I can do anything..."
Ye Fan continued to tease: "Is it really possible to do anything?"
Nalan Xueyan's pretty face turned red and she lowered her head: "Yes...but you can't bully me..."
"Why am I bullying you?"
Ye Fan shook his head and straightened his face: "I need your hands!"
"Ah? Can you use both hands?"
Last night, Nalan Fengyun did a lot of psychological construction for Nalan Xueyan!
Even some old ladies in the mansion were invited by Nalan Fengyun overnight to give Nalan Xueyan an adult lesson! Before the young ladies from big families get married, there are old ladies like this who specialize in taking classes!
With some pictures, Nalan Yanran's little head is now full of those pictures.
Although, in some pictures, both hands are used.
However, Nalan Xueyan was ready to sacrifice herself: "Is it enough to just use my hands?"
Ye Fan smiled and said: "What? You don't know how?"
"Uh...I've learned."
